subject: Repricing request: convert PAYG to committed 12mo bundle — CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Repricing request: convert PAYG to committed 12mo bundle — CFO signoff needed

Hi team,

Quick context: WaveHealth (Elena Morales) asked whether we can convert their current PAYG pilot into a 12-month committed bundle to stabilize spend and get us scale. They are proposing a 12-month, $1.2M committed spend (annualized) in return for a deeper discount and waived onboarding surcharge. Current ARR run-rate on PAYG is approx $90k/month.

Customer ask (summary):
- Convert PAYG pilot to 12-month committed bundle, $1.2M total committed (monthly invoiced).
- Requesting 35% off list for year 1, onboarding surcharge waived, and inclusion of one premium support seat.
- Wants start date 2026-12-01 to align with their fiscal planning.

Why this matters:
- Large customer in our target vertical (digital therapeutics) with multi-region plans; potential upsell to Dedicated in 2027.
- Without commitment, they are price-sensitive and may consider parallel offers.

Attached: SOW v3 (redlines) and my run-rate/cost model with margin impact.

Ask: I need VP/CFO signoff on the concession (discount + waive surcharge) or a counter with guardrails we can present to customer this week. Please see the cost-model; highlights below:
- Net margin (post-discount, post-burst cost estimate) drops ~18 percentage points at 35% off.
- At a 25% discount with a 60% usage floor, margin impact is manageable and preserves the onboarding fee recovery.

Proposed expedient approvals to keep momentum:
1) Approve a 30% one-year introductory discount, waive onboarding but retain a $30k implementation milestone tied to success metrics; OR
2) Approve 25% discount + onboarding surcharge waived only if they commit to >= 60% of committed tokens usage in quarter 1; else onboarding billed.

Customer is asking for final terms by EOD Tue (11/23). I can take the approved language to Elena and get DocuSign started.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Connor — thanks for the clear summary and model. A few quick notes before we put this in front of Marissa for signoff:

- I agree that a straight 35% concession is high on margin impact unless tied to real usage guarantees.
- If you must move customer off PAYG for cadence and retention, prefer option (2) with the usage floor + clawback language. That keeps us protected and is easier for Finance to reconcile.
- Please build a short one-page concession memo (one-pager) listing: rationale, expected NPV uplift, payback, and the exact legal fallback (clawback trigger).

Kimberly
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

P.S. Tag Marissa for final signoff; include HubSpot deal link and the one-pager when you escalate.

Marissa — forwarding the thread. Per Kimberly, I prepared a 1-page concession memo and attached the cost model (highlighted scenarios). Key ask summarized: we need VP/CFO signoff to offer WaveHealth either:

A) 30% off year-1, waive onboarding surcharge, require $30k milestone payment tied to activation (implementation), OR
B) 25% off year-1, waive onboarding surcharge only if usage >= 60% of committed tokens in Q1 (clawback if not met).

Impact overview (from cost-model):
- Scenario A: protects renewal probability but reduces gross margin by ~16 points in year 1; NPV positive if upsell to Dedicated occurs in 18 months.
- Scenario B: margin hit ~9 percentage points with clawback mechanics; lower risk to revenue quality.

Attachments included: WaveHealth_SOW_v3.pdf, wavehealth-cost-model-connor.xlsx, concession-onepager.pdf (attached inline). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789/WAVE-2026-1173

Customer timeline: Elena expects legal-friendly terms by EOD Tue 11/23 to align procurement.

Can you confirm direction or provide specific language you want me to present? If approved, I will get Legal looped for the clawback clause and send DocuSign.

Thanks — appreciate the quick look.
Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Connor / Kim — reviewed the memo and cost model. Given strategic fit (vertical focus, referenceability potential, clear upsell path) I will approve a conditional concession with the following binding terms:

1) Offer: 25% off list on committed 12-month bundle (WAVE-2026-1173), onboarding surcharge waived conditional on signature.
2) Usage guardrail: Customer must achieve >=60% of committed tokens in Q1. If usage <60%, a pro-rated clawback will apply on month 2 invoice to recover the onboarding economics (formula: (60% - actual_usage%) * onboarding_fee).
3) Implementation milestone: customer to pay $15k at signing (non-refundable) and $15k on production go-live (staged). This replaces a full onboarding waiver and reduces our exposure.
4) Premium support seat included for first 6 months; renews at standard rate thereafter.
5) Legal to add explicit clawback and audit rights. Finance/RevOps (Rishi) to record concession in HubSpot under WAVE-2026-1173 and mark the deal as "concession-approved" with reference to this email.

Please present these exact bullets to Elena and attach the SOW with the added milestone and clawback language. Rishi — once you mark the concession, coordinate with Legal for the revised contract language and route to DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations & Pricing
Redwood Inference
